notes.content:

notes.title: Shopping Empire Tycoon : Level 1-2-3 Arrangement
notes.content:
*More Customers And Automatic Days Brought For Level 1 - 2 - 3.

*Part of Levels 1-2-3 Has Been Changed To Offer More Active And Faster Gameplay Throughout Gameplay Time.

*Due to This Change, 3 Achievements were Deleted:
Thief Achievement.
Security Camera&Alarm Achievement.
Business Man Achievement.(Level 3 At the End of the Day, Shop Buying).

*If You Want To Be A Small Market Owner, Tech Shop Owner Or Jewellery Shop Owner Again, I Suggest You Try Again.

notes.title: Shopping Empire Tycoon : Halloween Level Update
notes.content:
ENGLİSH :

With This Update;

*Buttons To Adjust Music And Sound Fx Level Have Been Added.

*10 New Unlockable Achievements Have Been Added. The Hardest New Achievement Is To Sell 10.000 Pumpkins.

*Level Selection Panel Has Been Added. Now You Can Start From Any Level You Want.

*Special Halloween Level Gas Been Added (Happy Halloween!)

*6 Quests Are Coming With The New Halloween Level

*Halloween Level Has New Customer Types. Play To Find Out!

*Fullscreen Adaptation For 1920x1080.

notes.title: Shopping Empire Tycoon : Level 4 Is Done
notes.content:
ENGLİSH:


All Levels of Music Bugs Fixed. New Level Finished. 

With New Level Second Hand Vehicle Purchase and Rental Feature Added.

The Vehicle Store is Open 24/7, You Do Not Have To Press The "New Day" Button To Switch To The Next Day.

Much More Than Just 1 Or 2 Customers Will Arrive In Your New Shop Now.

You Will Be Able To Increase Your Cars Selling Percentages In The Store. This Way, You Will Be More Profitable.

This Content Will Add You An Average 2 Hours of Gameplay.

You Will Become A Real Estate Agent At Level 5.

TÜRKÇE:

İlk Olarak Müzikler İle Alakalı Hatayı Giderdim, Yeni Seviyeyi Bitirdim.

Bu Seviye Geldikten Sonra Artık 2.El Araç Alım Ve Kiralama Yapabileceksiniz.

Dükkanınız Artık 24 Saat Açık, Artık Yeni Güne Geçmek İçin "Yeni Gün" Butonuna Tıklamanıza Gerek Yok.

Artık Dükkanınıza 1 Veya 2 Den Fazla Müşteri Gelecek, Umduğunuz Ticarethaneyi Oluşturmak Artık Çok Daha Kolay.

Müşterilerin, Dükkanınızdaki Bir Arabayı Alma Yüzdesini Arttırabileceksiniz, Bu Sayede Daha Fazla Kar Elde Edeceksiniz,

Bu İçerik Size Ortalama 2 Saatlik Oynanış Sunacaktır.

5 Level Eklendiğinde Bir Emlakçı Olacaksınız.
